        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderForPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_DevelopmentProcess" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship or additional responsibilities)"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Split work and feedback"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" name="Provide feedback and evaluation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Join work and feedback"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Milestones" name="" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PromotionNotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_DevelopmentProcess" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="Event_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Event_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" targetRef="Task_PerformanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="End_PromotionNotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="End_EmployeePromoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When The description names a message that a process event sends or waits for, so the model needs a message event definition.: Place the event's name on the event element itself (or on a referenced bpmn:message element). On the bpmn:messageEventDefinition, set only its id and messageRef attributes, and never give it a name attribute, because the BPMN 2.0.2 XSD does not allow one.

rules.instruction: When the description states that a review leads to an approval decision, that only the approved outcome is then carried out, and that the approved outcome consists of several actions that must all be done before the process moves on: Model the review as a task, and the approval decision as an exclusive gateway with a conditioned approved branch and a separate non-approved branch that ends in its own end event. On the approved branch, first place a task that carries out the approval, then open a parallel gateway that splits into one task per required action, and close those tasks with a matching parallel gateway join before the next step. Do not skip the approval task or route the approved actions directly from the decision gateway.
rules.situation: the description states that a review leads to an approval decision, that only the approved outcome is then carried out, and that the approved outcome consists of several actions that must all be done before the process moves on

rules.instruction: When the description states that the flow terminates in one of two alternative actions performed on the subject, with each action named in the description: Place an exclusive gateway at the point where the alternative is chosen. After each branch, model the named action as its own task, labeled with the action the description names, and connect that task to its own end event. Do not model an action only as an end event labeled with the resulting state, and do not merge the alternative action tasks into one task.
rules.situation: the description states that the process ends once the subject is moved into a new state by a described transition, after a set of approved actions has been completed

rules.instruction: When the description states that work on one activity continues in parallel with another activity or feedback stream, and it states no condition, decision or criterion at the point where those concurrent branches split or rejoin: Model the split with a parallel gateway and close the concurrent branches with a matching parallel gateway that waits for all of them. Do not insert exclusive gateways at the split or join, and do not add condition labels to these branches. Use an exclusive gateway only where the description names a decision with alternative outcomes.
rules.situation: the description states that work on one activity continues in parallel with another activity or feedback stream, and it states no condition, decision or criterion at the point where those concurrent branches split or rejoin

rules.instruction: When the description states a review or approval outcome that can be approved or not approved, where the approved outcome leads to a finalization activity and the not-approved outcome ends the process on a separate branch: Model the outcome as an exclusive decision gateway placed directly after the review activity, with one outgoing flow for each outcome. Give the not-approved flow its own terminal end event. Do not route the approved flow to a termination or a shared end before the finalization activity. Use an exclusive gateway only where the outcome selects one branch, and do not add it to parallel branches.
rules.situation: the description states a review or approval outcome that can be approved or not approved, where the approved outcome leads to a finalization activity and the not-approved outcome ends the process on a separate branch
